cards.title: Google Removes Visible Watermark from AI Generations
cards.body: Google now allows users to disable visible watermarks on AI-generated images. Invisible benchmarks remain embedded to identify AI-generated content.

cards.title: Meta Releases Open-Weight AI Model Glimmer
cards.body: Meta launched Glimmer, an open-weight AI model anyone can download and run locally. This contrasts with Muse Spark, Meta's more powerful model locked behind proprietary APIs.

cards.title: Kog Optimizes GPU Inference for AI Workflows
cards.body: French startup Kog challenges the notion that GPUs poorly suit agentic AI workflows. The company is developing methods to squeeze more inference performance from existing hardware.

cards.title: Natural Gas Price Surge Threatens AI Data Centers
cards.body: Natural gas prices could triple in parts of the U.S., creating massive cost pressures for hyperscalers. AI infrastructure operators may face unexpectedly high electricity bills.

cards.title: Writer Launches New AI Model with Lower Costs
cards.body: Writer introduced a new AI model built on Z.ai's open-source GLM-5.2 framework. The system offers deployment-ready capabilities while significantly reducing token costs.

cards.title: Databricks Raises $5B at $190B Valuation
cards.body: Databricks closed a $5 billion funding round despite initially targeting $1 billion. High investor demand pushed the AI infrastructure company's valuation to $190 billion.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches Ultrafast Mode for GPT-5.6 Sol
cards.body: OpenAI introduced 'Ultrafast,' a new mode making GPT-5.6 Sol run 14x faster. The preview aims to attract enterprise customers seeking improved performance.

cards.title: IBM Partnerships with OpenAI for Enterprise AI
cards.body: IBM plans to train and certify tens of thousands of consultants on OpenAI technologies. The partnership strengthens both companies' enterprise AI offerings.

cards.title: Anthropic AI Agents Create Unexpected Turf Wars
cards.body: Anthropic researchers discovered AI agents can clash, collude, and coordinate in unanticipated ways. The findings raise questions about whether current safety tests adequately measure multi-agent system risks.

cards.title: OpenAI Hires New Chief Revenue Officer
cards.body: OpenAI replaced CRO Denise Dresser after nine months with Dali Rajic from Wiz. Rajic brings experience as president and COO of the cybersecurity company.

cards.title: Microsoft Consolidates Copilot Apps, Cuts Features
cards.body: Microsoft merged its consumer and business Copilot applications into one platform. The company discontinued AI-generated podcasts, Group Chats, Deep Research, and the Mico character.

cards.title: Nvidia's $500B Plan Protects GPU Value
cards.body: Nvidia developed a strategy to prevent GPU value depreciation through new financing models. The plan encourages continued AI infrastructure investment from financial institutions.

cards.title: Apple Negotiates Payments for News to Siri
cards.body: Apple considered nine-figure payments to publishers for providing current news to Siri. The deal aims to enhance Siri's real-time information capabilities.

cards.title: Anthropic Watermarks Raise Claude Usage Concerns
cards.body: Anthropic's new watermarking system identifies Claude outputs, creating backlash from users. Some worry the watermarks will expose AI tool usage in professional and educational settings.

cards.title: Amazon Trains on Twitch Content by Default
cards.body: Amazon will use Twitch streamers' content for AI training unless creators opt out. Twitch's CPO acknowledged that opt-in would result in minimal participation.

cards.title: AI Coding Startup Cognition Pursues $40B Valuation
cards.body: Cognition is reportedly raising a new mega-round at a $40 billion valuation. The move comes just months after closing a $1 billion Series A at $26 billion.

cards.title: AI Pioneers Debate Open Source and Regulation
cards.body: Geoffrey Hinton, Fei-Fei Li, and Andrew Ng discussed AI safety, open-source access, and global competition at Ai4. The experts debated balancing innovation with responsible AI development.

cards.title: Thrive Holdings Raises $2B for Enterprise AI
cards.body: Thrive Holdings closed a $2 billion funding round at a $12 billion valuation. Investors included SoftBank, D1 Capital Partners, and Altimeter Capital.

cards.title: Automattic's AI CRM Mesh Launches on Android
cards.body: Mesh, an AI-powered contacts and relationship management app, is now available on Android. The Automattic app helps users manage professional and personal relationships.

cards.title: Google Allows Removal of AI Generation Watermarks
cards.body: Users can now disable visible watermarks on Google's AI-generated images, though invisible benchmarks remain to identify AI content. The move balances user preference with content attribution tracking.

cards.title: Meta Releases Glimmer Open-Weight AI Model
cards.body: Meta launched Glimmer, an open-weight AI model anyone can download and run locally, contrasting with its proprietary Muse Spark. The release accompanies Zuckerberg's letter on democratizing AI access.

cards.title: Kog Optimizes GPU Inference for AI Workflows
cards.body: French startup Kog challenges the assumption that GPUs are poorly suited for agentic AI workflows. The company aims to squeeze more inference efficiency from existing GPU hardware.

cards.title: Writer AI Model Reduces Token Deployment Costs
cards.body: Writer introduced a new AI model built on Z.ai's open-source GLM-5.2, designed to lower deployment expenses. The system promises enterprise-ready capabilities at significantly reduced pricing.

cards.title: Databricks Raises $5B at $190B Valuation
cards.body: Databricks raised $5 billion after investors demanded higher valuations than planned, reaching $190 billion. CEO Ali Ghodsi cited AI's expensive infrastructure demands as driving investor appetite.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches Ultrafast GPT-5.6 Sol Mode
cards.body: OpenAI unveiled an Ultrafast preview mode making GPT-5.6 Sol run 14x faster than standard versions. The speedup targets enterprise users seeking high-performance AI inference.

cards.title: IBM Partners with OpenAI for Enterprise AI
cards.body: IBM will train and certify tens of thousands of consultants on OpenAI technologies through this partnership. The deal strengthens IBM's enterprise AI deployment capabilities.

cards.title: Anthropic AI Agents Clash in Multi-Agent Study
cards.body: Anthropic researchers discovered AI agents can unexpectedly clash, collude, and coordinate when working on identical tasks. The findings raise safety concerns about multi-agent system risks.

cards.title: OpenAI Hires New Chief Revenue Officer
cards.body: OpenAI replaced CRO Denise Dresser after nine months, appointing Wiz's Dali Rajic to lead sales. The executive shuffle continues at the AI frontier lab.

cards.title: Microsoft Merges Copilot Apps, Kills AI Features
cards.body: Microsoft combined consumer and business Copilot apps while discontinuing AI-generated podcasts, Group Chats, and Deep Research. The consolidation simplifies its AI assistant strategy.

cards.title: Nvidia Plans $500B GPU Financing Strategy
cards.body: Nvidia aims to prevent its GPUs from losing value through a financing plan attracting new lenders to AI infrastructure buildouts. The strategy addresses aging GPU market concerns.

cards.title: Anthropic Watermarks Raise Privacy Concerns
cards.body: Anthropic's new watermarking system identifies Claude usage, frustrating users worried about detection in work and academic settings. The privacy complaints highlight tension between AI safety and user concerns.

cards.title: Amazon Defaults to Training on Twitch Content
cards.body: Amazon will train AI models on Twitch streamers' content by default unless creators opt out. Twitch CPO admitted opt-in would result in near-zero participation.

cards.title: Cognition AI Startup Valued at $40 Billion
cards.body: AI coding startup Cognition is reportedly in talks to raise another mega round just months after a $1 billion Series B at $26 billion. The valuation jump reflects booming enterprise AI demand.

cards.title: AI Pioneers Debate Open Source vs. Regulation
cards.body: Geoffrey Hinton, Fei-Fei Li, and Andrew Ng discussed AI safety, open-source access, and US competitiveness at Ai4. The panel explored balancing innovation with emerging safety concerns.

cards.title: Thrive Holdings Raises $2B for Enterprise AI
cards.body: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings secured $2 billion funding at $12 billion valuation from SoftBank, D1 Capital, and others. The capital fuels enterprise AI adoption efforts.

cards.title: Kids Share Honest Thoughts on AI Tools
cards.body: Children expressed varied perspectives on AI, from using it for minor cheating to finding inspiring applications. The independent Anyway magazine documented authentic youth AI perceptions.

cards.title: OpenAI and Anthropic in AI Price War
cards.body: OpenAI and Anthropic are competing aggressively on pricing as Chinese AI rivals gain market ground. The price pressures intensify competition in the generative AI market.

cards.title: Google Releases Gemini 3.7 Flash Model
cards.body: Google announced Gemini 3.7 Flash just three weeks after its previous release. The rapid iteration reflects intense competition in AI model development.

cards.title: Anthropic Could Reach $2 Trillion Valuation
cards.body: Anthropic is projected to potentially be worth $2 trillion upon going public. The valuation reflects massive investor confidence in Claude and enterprise AI demand.

cards.title: Claude's Watermark Remains Invisible for Now
cards.body: Anthropic's new Scarlet Letter watermark on Claude output remains invisible to users and most detection methods. The invisible marking raises questions about long-term detection durability.
